name: Omar Al-Sharafi
bio: A reciter of the Quran and of classical Arabic poetry in Bahrain, who has led the night prayers of Ramadan and posts recitations, sermons and poems on his YouTube channel. With Alqimmah Studio in Bahrain he recorded the Mu'allaqat of Imru' al-Qays, Antara and Amr ibn Kulthum, and his own channel carries Zuhayr's Mu'allaqa and al-Jurjani's poem in mim.
